stories.title: Beyond 26/11: Other major terror attacks in Mumbai over the years
stories.summary: On November 26, 2008, 10 Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) terrorists from Pakistan arrived by sea and killed 166 people, including 18 security personnel, besides injuring more than 300 others during a 60-hour siege of Mumbai. The terrorists targeted several high-profile locations, including the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, the Oberoi Trident, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus and Nariman House.

stories.title: Hrithik Roshan’s father Rakesh Roshan’s firm leases Mumbai office space at ₹7 lakh monthly rent to Fuji Silvertech Concrete Private Limited
stories.summary: Filmmaker Rakesh Roshan-led Filmkraft Productions (India) Private Limited has leased a 2,727 sq ft commercial office space at Lotus Corporate Park in Goregaon East, Mumbai, to Fuji Silvertech Concrete Private Limited for five years at an initial monthly rent of ₹ 7 lakh, according to property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix.

stories.title: Bengaluru cab driver claims Rs 20k daily income, says he owns 10 cars in Mumbai
stories.summary: A routine cab ride to Majestic in Bengaluru turned into an unexpected lesson in entrepreneurship for one passenger. What began as a casual conversation about life and work soon revealed a business model that left him surprised. The driver was not just earning through Uber rides. The passenger, identified as Sankit on social media platform X, shared the encounter in a post dated November 21, 2026.

stories.title: Walmart-owned Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down
stories.summary: Walmart-owned Flipkart on Wednesday announced that chief executive officer Kalyan Krishnamurthy would conclude his tenure after more than 11 years with the company, marking the end of a leadership stint during which the e-commerce business grew more than fivefold.

stories.title: Mumbai: 6-year-old girl dies after falling from 11th-floor in Vasai's Naigaon
stories.summary: A tragic accident claimed the life of a six-year-old girl after she fell from a lobby window on the 11th floor of Navkar Tower in Naigaon East in the Vasai-Virar, officials said on Wednesday. As per IANS, the incident has plunged her family into grief, while residents of the housing society are also mourning the child's untimely death.

stories.title: Mumbai's Borivali railway station to get rail coach restaurant
stories.summary: Western Railway (WR) is set to reintroduce a rail coach restaurant at Mumbai's Borivali railway station as part of its efforts to generate non-fare revenue (NFR) and enhance passenger amenities. Under the initiative, an old railway passenger coach will be refurbished and converted into a restaurant equipped with modern dining facilities, including a rooftop dining area.

stories.title: Thane Crime Branch arrests five in Mumbra dacoity case, cracks seven other cases
stories.summary: The Thane Crime Branch has arrested five members of a gang allegedly involved in targeting bungalows and farmhouses across Thane district, solving eight cases, including the November 17 dacoity in Mumbra, officials said on Wednesday (November 25, 2026). 39 lakh from the accused. stories.title: Navi Mumbai Airport Crosses 4 Million Passengers Milestone Ahead Of First Anniversary
stories.summary: 1 million passengers since commencing commercial operations on December 25, 2025, the airport said in a statement on Wednesday. Ahead of its first anniversary, the airport has recorded 4,101,409 passengers and 31,043 passenger aircraft movements. It has also handled 40,868 metric tonnes of cargo as of November 15.

stories.title: Mumbai: BMC demolishes 10 structures for Mahim Causeway bridge project
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has demolished 10 project-affected structures to clear a major hurdle in the reconstruction and widening of the Mahim Causeway bridge. The demolition drive, carried out on Monday, November 23, marks a significant step towards reviving the infrastructure project, which had been delayed for the past six to seven years.

stories.title: Mumbai Water Cut: BMC Announces 24-Hour Supply Disruption On Nov 26-27; Check Affected Areas
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has announced a 24-hour water supply disruption in several parts of Mumbai on November 26 and 27 due to scheduled repairs to major water pipelines between Powai High-Level Reservoir No. 1 (PHLR-1) and Sahar Village. According to the civic body, repair work will begin at 9 am on Thursday, November 26, and continue until 9 am on Friday, November 27, 2026.

stories.title: Mumbai: BMC Orders Vigilance Probe Into ₹37 Crore Digital Classroom Project Over Missing Educational Content
stories.summary: Mumbai: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has ordered a vigilance probe into its Rs 37 crore digital classroom project for civic-run schools. The project has reportedly faced implementation issues, as Interactive Flat Panels (IFPs) installed in several schools lacked educational content, for teaching.

stories.title: Mumbai racing season from Nov. 29
stories.summary: The Mahalaxmi race course is gearing up for an exciting Mumbai Season, which will begin on Sunday, November 29, and conclude on April 11, 2027. The season will feature 28 race days with advertised prize money exceeding ₹25 crores. Around 771 horses, including 290 two-year-olds, along with 29 trainers and 45 jockeys, would be stationed at the course.

stories.title: Tiger Shroff shooting case accused a minor, produce him before Juvenile Justice Board, says Mumbai court
stories.summary: The minor was arrested on Oct 19, a day after gunmen fired at the actor’s vehicle in Juhu, and has spent a total of 37 days in police and judicial custody. Special judge Satyanarayan R Navander ordered the teenager’s production before JJB after the investigating officer verified his school and birth records during a court-directed age inquiry.

stories.title: Execution of proclamation orders against Hafiz Saeed, five other 26/11 accused still awaited
stories.summary: While the trial in the 26/11 terror attacks is on against Zabiuddin Ansari alias Abu Jundal, the handler who taught the 10 Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorists Hindi, steps to execute the proclamation orders against six other perpetrators, including Lashkar operatives Hafiz Saeed and Zaki-ur-Rehman Lakhvi, are yet to be taken.

stories.title: 7-10 yrs in jail, ₹10 cr fine for paper leaks among Maharashtra panel’s exam reform proposals
stories.summary: The V Radha committee, appointed by the Maharashtra government to reform the Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) , recruitment examination system, and curb paper leaks, submitted its second report on Monday recommending seven to 10 years’ imprisonment and a minimum fine of ₹ 10 crore for those involved in paper leaks.

stories.title: Western Railway To Build ₹98-Crore Coaching Depot At Currey Road To Boost Long-Distance Train Capacity
stories.summary: The proposed depot will come up on railway land between Currey Road and Lower Parel. The land has been handed over to Western Railway, while the existing railway store depot on the premises will be shifted by Central Railway to Thakurli. Construction will begin after the relocation and clearance of the site.

stories.title: Chandak Group Raises ₹200 Crore From Japan’s Mori Trust And Route78° Partners For Chembur Residential
stories.summary: Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], November 24: Mumbai-based real estate developer Chandak Group has secured an investment of ₹200 crore from Japan’s Mori Trust and a fund advised by Route78° Partners for its residential project, Chandak Highscape City , located in Chembur, Mumbai.

stories.title: Thane: 53 hospitalised after eating shawarma in Bhiwandi
stories.summary: As many as 53 people, including 17 children and 25 women, have been hospitalised following suspected food poisoning after consuming shawarma from a roadside eatery in Bhiwandi town of Maharashtra’s Thane district, an official said on Wednesday. The affected persons are undergoing treatment at the state-run Indira Gandhi Memorial (IGM) Hospital in Bhiwandi.

stories.title: Bombay HC Seeks Infrastructure Plan From Railways, State To Curb Deaths On Mumbai Suburban Tracks
stories.summary: A bench of Chief Justice MC Tripathi and Justice Advait Sethna was hearing a petition by Sarosh Mehta seeking implementation of recommendations made by a High Court-appointed committee in an earlier matter concerning deaths of commuters either due to falling from overcrowded trains or crossing railway tracks. stories.title: BMC announces five-day closure of wood-fired cremation facility in Kandivali
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Wednesday announced that the wood-fired cremation facility at Dahanukarwadi crematorium in Mumbai's Kandivali West will remain temporarily closed for five days to facilitate chimney replacement work. The facility, which falls under the civic body's R South Ward, will remain shut from Saturday, November 28, to Wednesday, December 2, 2026, both days inclusive.

stories.title: Mumbai monsoon 2027: BMC begins preparations to tackle waterlogging concerns
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Wednesday held a pre-monsoon preparedness meeting for 2027 , directing various agencies to strengthen coordination and undertake preventive measures to minimise waterlogging, road traffic disruptions and interruptions to suburban railway services during the rainy season. Additional Municipal Commissioner (City) Prajakta Varma-Lavangare directed officials to draw lessons from incidents reported during the 2026 monsoon and utilise the next six months to undertake planned preventive works.

stories.title: Mumbai Police Housing Township Project cost increases by 65% 11 months after Maharashtra cabinet’s approval
stories.summary: Within 11 months of securing cabinet approval for the Rs 20,000-crore Mumbai Police Housing Township Project, which includes redeveloping many of the dilapidated police colonies to bring relief to the force’s 51,308 personnel, the estimated cost has reportedly escalated by 65% to around Rs 33,000 crore.A senior official involved in the process stated that the project cost may go up to Rs 33,000 crore, including taxes, and the state cabinet will soon take a final…

stories.title: Mumbai Crime Branch Busts Alleged Cyber Fraud Bank Account Racket In Dharavi; 2 Arrested
stories.summary: Acting on a tip-off received by Police Inspector Sawant, a team from Unit 8 conducted a raid at Room No. M. Thevar Marg, Thevar Nagar, Dharavi, on November 14. The main accused, Wasim Javed Khan (36), was found inside the premises along with his wife, Rubina Khan.

stories.title: Mumbai: Consumer Commission Orders Goregaon Builder To Hand Over Flat Within 2 Months, Pay 9 Per Cent Interest

stories.title: Mumbai: Kurla’s Pramod Mahajan Garden Inspection Reveals Civic Neglect; BMC Moves To Blacklist Contractor
stories.summary: Mumbai, November 25, 2026: Following the assault on a young couple by a group of boys at Kurla’s Pramod Mahajan Garden, a joint inspection by Market and Gardens Committee Chairperson Hetal Gala and Health Committee Chairman Harish Bhandirge on Wednesday laid bare a shocking state of civic neglect.

stories.title: Bombay high court stays arbitral award against MMRDA and in favour of Lodha in Wadala project, subject to authority depositing Rs 145 crore
stories.summary: Bombay high court provided a conditional stay on an arbitration award for Rs 238 crore. The award mandated MMRDA to compensate Lodha Developers for losses from reduced built-up area. MMRDA is required to deposit Rs 145 crore within six weeks for the stay to remain effective. The dispute arose over height permissions for a commercial project in Wadala Truck Terminal.

stories.title: BMC orders sprinklers, covered excavated material at Mumbai Coastal Road
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Wednesday, November 25, directed officials and contractors working on the Mumbai Coastal Road (North) Project to strictly implement pollution-control measures. The civic body has also directed them to cover excavated material during storage and transportation and deploy adequate water sprinklers to prevent dust pollution at construction sites.

stories.title: A commitment to strengthen our Constitution
stories.summary: On November 26, 1949, the Constituent Assembly adopted our Constitution. Today, we remember Dr Rajendra Prasad, Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar and every member of the Constituent Assembly. For a nation as diverse as Bharat, with its numerous faiths, languages, customs and schools of thought, it is important that the Constitution has a resonance far beyond the precincts of Parliament and the courts.

stories.title: India wins Visitors’ Lion for best national pavilion at 61st Venice Art Biennale from among 100 participants
stories.summary: India won the Visitors’ Lion for the Best National Pavilion at the recently-concluded 61st Venice Art Biennale in Italy , from among a 100 national participants. Chicago -born musician and artist Nick Cave won the Visitors' Lion for Best Participant.

stories.title: Congress wins majority of Zila Pramukh posts in Rajasthan polls
stories.summary: After its decisive victory in the last week’s Panchayati Raj elections, the Opposition Congress in Rajasthan on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) took control of 24 of the 37 zila parishads which elected their heads, while the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party secured 10 Zila Pramukh posts despite having a majority in just five rural district bodies.

stories.title: Airtel to invest ₹1,200 cr in 3 data centers in Assam
stories.summary: Bharti Airtel plans to invest around ₹1,200 crore to establish three data centres in Assam, strengthening the state’s digital infrastructure and emerging as a technology investment destination. The company will invest ₹700 crore in a data centre in Guwahati, while the proposed facilities in Jorhat and Silchar will attract a combined investment of ₹500 crore.

stories.title: State cabinet approves amendments to Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act
stories.summary: Officials said the amendments to the Act were intended to ensure citizens can access public services in a timely and transparent manner. “Responsibility will be fixed on officers and employees for delayed services, while citizens will receive complete information on the first, second and third appeals,” said officials.

stories.title: Suspected cattle smuggler killed after car rams into truck on KMP E-way in Nuh: Police
stories.summary: A suspected cattle smuggler died while three others got injured after the car they were escaping in the wrong direction to avoid police, collided head-on with a truck on the Kundli-Manesar-Palwal (KMP) Expressway in Nuh on Wednesday, police said on Thursday. One of the two cattle being smuggled in the car also died in the accident, police said, adding the other survived.

stories.title: Delhi to get 40 more arogya mandirs next month, 2 new hospitals in 2027: CM
stories.summary: Chief Minister Rekha Gupta on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) said that 40 more Ayushman Arogya Mandirs will become operational next month and two new hospitals with a total of over 1,800 beds in North and West Delhi will be operational next year. The two hospitals are under construction, and one is likely to be operational in the first half of the year and the second later on, according to officials.

stories.title: Justice Vikram Nath applauds Justice Kaul’s candour amid debate over memoir
stories.summary: Justice Vikram Nath on Wednesday applauded the candour with which former Supreme Court judge Sanjay Kishan Kaul has written his memoir, Without Fear or Favour, but steered clear of endorsing or disagreeing with his former colleague’s observations about the Supreme Court and its functioning, saying he did not intend to turn the book launch into “another hearing”.

stories.title: Supreme Court nixes Allahabad HC order for Rahul’s assets probe
stories.summary: Supreme Court on Wednesday quashed an Allahabad HC order asking the CBI and ED to probe complaints about leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi’s alleged disproportionate assets and directed the HC to conduct a fresh hearing on the petition with an opportunity for him to oppose it.The top court principally set aside the order because of its ex parte nature, holding that not being given an opportunity to counter the allegations made in the PIL by…

stories.title: Woman gang-raped by colleagues at east Delhi cafe; three arrested
stories.summary: A 22-year-old woman was allegedly gang-raped by two male colleagues during a late-night gathering at a cafe in east Delhi’s Preet Vihar in the early hours of Tuesday (November 24, 2026). The police arrested three people, including two women, in connection with the case. Three other accused are on the run and efforts are under way to trace them, Deputy Commissioner of Police (East) Rajeev Kumar said.

stories.title: Assam CM lays foundation for Northeast’s first ₹50-crore defence manufacturing unit at Tulsibari in Rangia
stories.summary: Assam chief minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Wednesday laid the foundation stone for a defence equipment manufacturing facility being set up at Tulsibari in Rangia. A Mumbai-based company, Speed4 Defence Systems Private Limited, will initially invest around ₹ 50 crore to establish the facility on approximately 14 acres of land.

stories.title: At least two Indians among 11 injured in Houthi attack in Riyadh; New Delhi condemns strike
stories.summary: Two Indians were among those injured in an attack on a financial district in Riyadh that triggered strong condemnation from New Delhi. India also denounced continued strikes targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. “Two Indians are among those injured in the attack on Riyadh financial district.

stories.title: Bulls back in charge, Sensex jumps 1.5k points, hits 84k mark
stories.summary: Sensex and Nifty closed at fresh nine-month highs on Wednesday, led by banking stocks, Reliance Industries and select index heavyweights. Despite a mixed close in overnight US markets, Dalal Street opened sharply higher, driven mainly by nearly unabated foreign fund buying over the past month. Sensex opened 1,000 points higher and rose to an intraday high of 84,498, gaining over 2,050 points, before profit-taking pulled it lower.

stories.title: Omar government breaks silence on Sheshnag row, says lake safe

The minister, who was scheduled to visit the lake for an on-the-spot inspection on Tuesday, said he could not reach the site due to security concerns.

stories.title: Rupee hits 8-month high, wipes out this year’s losses

Rupee outperforms Asian peers, gains in six of past 7 sessionsThe inflows have lifted domestic stock markets, bringing benchmark indices close to erasing their losses for the year. A stronger rupee improves India's purchasing power and helps contain imported inflation.

stories.title: Free train travel facility extended to all trains for Chakra awardees
stories.summary: The Ministry of Railways, in consultation with the Ministry of Defence, has extended the complimentary train travel facility for Chakra-series gallantry awardees to all trains, including the Vande Bharat Express. The government provides complimentary rail travel in First Class and AC 2-Tier to recipients of the Param Vir Chakra, Ashoka Chakra, Maha Vir Chakra, Kirti Chakra, Vir Chakra, and Shaurya Chakra.

stories.title: ‘Left with no choice’: TVS chairman emeritus Venu Srinivasan’s daughter moves HC, seeks partition of his family assets | Business News
stories.summary: Lakshmi Venu, daughter of TVS Motor Company chairman emeritus Venu Srinivasan, has moved the Madras High Court seeking a partition of joint family assets in her father’s branch of the TVS business group and an allotment of her share.

stories.title: Boyfriend pushes woman to death from Bengaluru lodge window after argument
stories.summary: According to police, the woman's mother stated in her complaint that Aishwarya was in a relationship with Santhosh, who works at a private company. On November 19, Aishwarya and Santhosh went to a lodge, where they consumed alcohol in the evening. During the argument, Aishwarya said she would end her life.

stories.title: Sooraj Barjatya says he ‘let down’ Hrithik Roshan, Kareena Kapoor and Abhishek Bachchan with Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon
stories.summary: Filmmaker Sooraj Barjatya , known for his family dramas, directed the 2003 romantic comedy Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon , which revolved around a love triangle involving characters played by Kareena Kapoor , Hrithik Roshan and Abhishek Bachchan. stories.summary: The decision to prevent Cockroach Janata Party leader Saurav Das from going abroad to address a campus meeting in Oxford is an extreme show of governmental paranoia about its own educated, law-abiding citizens, for whom it promised Achche Din not too long ago. stories.title: Three persons killed in accident in Tiruvannamalai
stories.summary: A family of three persons were killed in a road accident after a two-wheeler that they were travelling was hit by a car on Chittoor–Cuddalore High Road near Kalasapakkam town in Tiruvannamalai on Wednesday. Police identified the deceased as S. Yoganatham, 38; Deepa, 34; and Durga, 6. Injured son was identified as Bharani Kumar, 9.

stories.title: SC declines to hear interim bail pleas of Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam pending UAPA ruling
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Wednesday refused to entertain pleas for interim bail for former JNU scholar Umar Khalid and activist Sharjeel Imam in the larger conspiracy linked to the 2020 Delhi riots case and said that a decision on their release will have to await a decision by a larger bench on whether delay in trial can be a ground for bail under the stringent Unlawful Activities Prevention Act (UAPA).

stories.title: Tata trust can invest Rs 150 crore in shares
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Charity Commissioner has approved the Tata Social Welfare Trust's proposal to invest an amount of Rs 150 crore. This strategic move will not only help the trust earn returns on funds unavailable for immediate charitable needs but also ensure a thoughtful allocation across various investment platforms.

stories.title: Florida employer to pay $112,500 after accounting clerk's cancer-related dismissal claim
stories.summary: After undergoing cancer surgery, a Florida employee sought temporary accommodations, only to be let go by Schumacher Auto Group. The US Equal Employment Opportunity Commission has since accused the company of discrimination under the Americans with Disabilities Act. As part of a settlement, Schumacher will pay $112,500 in damages and revise their disability policies.

stories.title: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway
stories.summary: Thirty-one people have been killed and 21 others injured in a large fire on a busy highway in Cairo after a fuel tanker crashed, Egypt's health ministry says. Hospitals nearby treated patients suffering burns and smoke inhalation after the incident, which occurred on a section of a ring road in the Warraq neighbourhood, to the north of the old city centre, on Wednesday evening.

stories.title: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dies at 65
stories.summary: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the 1980s English new wave band Duran Duran , whose huge pop hits include “Hungry Like the Wolf,” “The Reflex” and “Rio” and whose rise up the charts was inextricably linked to the launch of MTV, has died. stories.title: Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt settle legal battle over French winery
stories.summary: Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie have settled a long-running legal battle over her sale of a stake in their French vineyard, which unfolded amid a bitter divorce. stories.title: Bad weather postpones Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade for first time ever
stories.summary: Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade will also be a first: Organisers made an unprecedented decision to postpone the event to Saturday (November 28, 2026) because of bad weather. The annual parade, originally scheduled for Thursday (November 26, 2026), has been moved “out of an abundance of caution” and following consultation with city officials about the severe weather, Macy’s said in a statement Wednesday.

stories.title: Two children among six dead after plane crash off Mississippi coast
stories.summary: Six people, including two children, have been found dead after a plane crashed off the coast of Mississippi on Tuesday, the US Coast Guard says. The Cessna 210 was on its way from New Orleans to Fort Myers, Florida, according to the flight tracking website FlightAware.

stories.title: Trump proposing new tariffs on 14 partners including China and EU
stories.summary: Donald Trump is proposing new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the European Union, that would go into effect early next year, the office of the US trade representative said on Wednesday. stories.title: Energy bills in Great Britain to rise 26% in January, lifting annual bills over £2,000
stories.summary: Millions of British households will face annual energy bills of more than £2,000 a year for the first time since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, as the cap on energy bills climbs for a third straight quarter.
